results.title: PUBG Mobile 1.6 patch notes: New Flora Menace Mode, Payload 2.0, and more
results.content: # PUBG Mobile 1.6 patch notes: New Flora Menace Mode, Payload 2.0, and more. The 1.6 update will, as predicted, bring a slew of new features and content to the game. The patch will include a new Flora Menace mode, as well as the reintroduction of Vikendi and a few other game modes, such as Payload 2.0, Runic Power, Infection, Survive Till Dawn, and others, which were removed by the developers in order to improve and optimize the game. When will the PUBG Mobile 1.6 update be available? The PUBG Mobile 1.6 update is set to launch on September 14, 2021, at 5:00 a.m. UTC, though it may take a few hours to reach all devices. *Flora Menace mode in PUBG Mobile 1.6 will be available to play on Erangel. We want PUBG MOBILE to be a game you like playing as well as a platform for you to discuss, brag about, and make new friends.
